target.title: fix(gateway): preserve optional catalog timeout when override is oversized
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Gateway server methods that request optional model-catalog metadata could fall back almost immediately when an oversized timeout override is supplied, making the optional metadata path skip sooner than the caller intended.

## Why This Change Was Made

The optional server-method catalog loader now resolves its override through the existing timer-safe timeout helper before scheduling the fallback timer. This keeps the existing default timeout behavior, clamps huge finite override values to Node's safe timer range, and stays within the Gateway server-method owner boundary used by the `agents`, `chat`, and `sessions` callers.

## User Impact

Gateway responses that include optional model-catalog metadata get predictable fallback timing even when an internal caller provides an oversized override. The primary response path still remains non-blocking when catalog loading is slow.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: oversized optional model-catalog timeout overrides are clamped before scheduling the slow-catalog fallback.
- Current-head proof at `97f0c4092defd773c71095e2193e222947ab4f91`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/optional-model-catalog.test.ts` passed with 2 files and 2 tests.
- Branch diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `PYTHONUTF8=1 python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Observed result: the regression test schedules `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` through the optional catalog loader and verifies the fallback timer uses `MAX_TIMER_TIMEOUT_MS` before returning `undefined` and logging the clamped delay.
